title: APEX: An Extensible and Dynamism-Aware Simulator for Automated Parallel Execution in LLM Serving
authors: Yi-Chien Lin; Woosuk Kwon; Ronald Pineda; Fanny Nina Paravecino
affiliations: University of Southern California, UC Berkeley, UCLA, Microsoft
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Quantization, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Selecting an optimal parallel execution plan for LLM serving is non-trivial because of the many factors involved (workload, parallelism, quantization, devices) and the dynamism of iteration-level batching; brute-force evaluation on real hardware is prohibitively expensive and prior simulators built for DNN training cannot capture LLM serving dynamics.
problem_statement.zh: 為 LLM 服務挑選最佳的平行執行計畫並不容易，因為涉及工作負載、平行策略、量化與裝置等眾多因素，並受 iteration-level batching 的動態性影響；於真實硬體進行窮舉評估的成本極高，而既有為 DNN 訓練設計的模擬器亦無法刻畫 LLM 服務的動態行為。

key_innovation.en: APEX, a dynamism-aware simulator that abstracts an LLM as Transformer IR composed of cells/blocks, generates parallel execution plans via Parallel Templates, uses operation-level offline profiling to estimate execution time, and simulates iteration-level batching to evaluate latency, TTFT, TPOT and energy across heterogeneous clusters.
key_innovation.zh: APEX 為一具有動態感知的模擬器：將 LLM 抽象為由 cell 與 block 構成的 Transformer IR；藉由 Parallel Templates 產生多種平行執行計畫；以 operation-level 離線 profiling 估計執行時間；並透過模擬 iteration-level batching 以評估異質叢集下的 latency、TTFT、TPOT 與能耗。

baselines_compared: Heuristic plans (TP within node + PP across nodes), vLLM, SGLang

key_improvements.en: Identifies execution plans up to 3.37x faster than heuristic baselines and up to 45% lower energy consumption versus latency-optimal plans; 71x faster than real GPU deployment and 1234x more cost-effective; average relative error of 10.7% on speedup prediction.
key_improvements.zh: 找出較啟發式基線最高快 3.37x 的執行計畫，並較 latency-optimal 計畫降低最多 45% 能耗；相較真實 GPU 部署快 71x，成本效益達 1234x；加速比預測的平均相對誤差為 10.7%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100 SXM (80GB), NVIDIA H200 SXM (141GB), Intel Xeon 6530 CPU (for simulation)
gpu_count: 8x H100 (single node), 16x H100 (multi-node, 2 nodes), 8x H200 (single node)
reported_accuracy: MAPE 10.7% (average relative error on speedup prediction)
validation_workloads: Azure LLM Inference traces (Summarization, Creation, Chat derived from paper-summarization, news-abstract and LMSYS-Chat-1M datasets)

scope_assumptions.en: Profiling focuses on key operators (attention, GEMM) while omitting minor operations, leading to slightly higher predicted TPOT than measured; assumes Poisson arrival; energy modeling does not explain operator-level variance; single Transformer block is simulated and extrapolated to the full model.
scope_assumptions.zh: Profiling 著重於 attention、GEMM 等關鍵運算子，省略次要運算，造成預測 TPOT 略高於實測；假設請求到達為 Poisson 分布；能耗建模無法解釋 operator 層級的變異；以單一 Transformer block 模擬並外推至完整模型。
